My Story

The chapters
that made me.

01

The Foundation

I graduated in June 2026 with an M.S. in Marketing Analysis from DePaul University’s Kellstadt Graduate School of Business, where every theory got tested against a real client. Consumer behavior, conjoint analysis, factor analysis, text analytics. The classroom ran as a laboratory, and the work went to actual stakeholders at Constellation Brands and InContext Solutions rather than into a grade book.

✦ DePaul University · Kellstadt GSB · Chicago, IL
02

The Marketer

At Keva Health, Inc. - a Lexington, Massachusetts company building remote patient monitoring technology - I found a proving ground unlike any other. The audience wasn't consumers browsing an app store. It was pulmonologists, allergists, and practice administrators: busy clinicians who had seen every pitch and trusted very few. I rebuilt their entire 2026 social media strategy from scratch. Summer ad campaigns. Back-to-school campaigns. Content that actually lands with clinical audiences.

✦ Keva Health, Inc. · Digital Health · B2B · Remote Patient Monitoring
03

The Analyst

Data without a story is just a spreadsheet. I translate raw numbers into actionable business strategies. I have built competitive intelligence reports for the remote patient monitoring space, designed data-driven retail planograms for InContext Solutions, and leveraged Python for deep sentiment mining at Constellation Brands. Whether I am running ANOVA models or Google Pixel conjoint analyses, the pattern is always the same: every number represents a real human decision, and my job is to find it.

ANOVA - Conjoint Analysis - Python - MAXQDA - Tableau
04

The Creator

Strategy without creative execution is just a plan. From SmartPack AI product positioning using Jobs-to-be-Done framing and OE/CI/PL price-performance curves, to World No Tobacco Day social posts and seasonal air quality content - creativity and structure are never separate in my work. I think visually, write concisely, and build campaigns that feel human even when the strategy is deeply analytical.

✦ Branding · Content Strategy · Campaign Design · Visual Thinking
